# Package-targeting flags are recomputed after distribution defaults at startup

MailGlue overwrites isFlatpak/isSnap on every startup after packager defaults are applied. Non-Linux clears both. Linux checks environment-variable presence first and only falls back to lowercased default-branch distribution.id when neither flag was found. The two flags are not mutually exclusive. NotificationFilter reads Boolean preferences through its generic targeting lists; the new inputs do not themselves display a notification or prove an authenticated container state.

Scope: In-app notification package targeting.
